workload.order: Repetitions 1 and 3 ran before then after per mode; repetition 2 ran after then before per mode.
workload.verification: Every case checked 25,600,000 ordered offsets and exact payload bytes. All 12 passed.

source_difference: The two complete, independently buildable snapshots differ in one file only: src/infrastructure/sqlite.rs. Its patch only replaces owned row decoding in decode_row with borrowed rusqlite ValueRef slices.
measurement_limits: Rust allocation counters cover whole-process cumulative traffic in the timed region and exclude SQLite C allocations. RSS is process lifetime peak including setup. Elapsed and process CPU include open/close; runtime also includes registration, drain, drop, and shutdown.
